name: AppSettings
description: Public-safe app-owned workspace branding and contact settings

settings_key.description: Stable settings record key, currently default

workspace_name.description: Public workspace name shown in the app header

short_label.description: Public short label or kicker shown above the workspace name

description.description: Short public-safe description of the workspace

support_slack_url.description: Optional HTTPS Slack support destination shown to signed-out visitors

support_email.description: Optional support email shown to signed-out visitors

support_slack_enabled.description: Whether signed-out visitors can use the Slack contact option

support_email_enabled.description: Whether signed-out visitors can use the email contact option

support_ai_help_desk_enabled.description: Whether signed-out visitors can open the AI Help Desk contact option
